servinfo.title: Clutch Operating Cylinder Assembly Removal and Installation

item.ptxt: Brake fluid is extremely damaging to painted surfaces.
If brake fluid contacts painted surfaces, immediately wipe it off and flush the surfaces with water thoroughly.
The clutch operating cylinder may lose its original performance if it is disassembled and reassembled.
Do not disassemble and repair the clutch operating cylinder.

s1.ptxt: Clean around brake master cylinder reservoir cap and take out fluid from brake master cylinder reservoir with syringe or the like.
Remove clamp (1) and disconnect clutch pipe joint (2).
Loosen clutch fluid pipe flare nut (1) at clutch operating cylinder assembly (2).
Remove clutch pipe joint sleeve (3) from transaxle, and then remove clutch fluid pipe (4).
Remove clutch operating cylinder assembly bolts.
Remove clutch operating cylinder assembly from transaxle.
Install clutch pipe joint sleeve (4) to transaxle.
Install clutch operating cylinder assembly (1) to transaxle and tighten clutch operating cylinder assembly bolts (2) temporarily by hand in numerical order (“1” – “3”).
Insert quick joint side of clutch fluid pipe (3) into clutch pipe joint sleeve.
Connect opposite side of clutch fluid pipe to clutch operating cylinder assembly and tighten flare nut (5) temporarily.
Tighten clutch operating cylinder assembly bolts to specified torque.
Tighten clutch fluid pipe flare nut to specified torque.
Install clamp (1), and connect clutch pipe joint (2).
Bleed clutch system and check clutch pedal free travel.
